summary: EXP-685 drafted: new part4 section 4.2.7b (insert after 4.2.7a). Dome publishes three conflicting coverage tables for the 12 Aug 2026 eclipse (predictions page, home page incl. BDV, archived V9 LOCKED). The archived V9 values were within 7 pp of DE421 obscuration; the current ones are 36-46 pp low at ESK/LER/NGK, halving the dome formula amplitude there. Home page claims 7 observatories >80% coverage: true of the real eclipse, 3 of 7 by its own table; its ranges also reverse E-PRED-B. ISS-3090 -18.22 vs -10.9 framing re-framed (single 1.672 application is a quiet-day re-audit, not a contradiction; consistent with EXP-687 rev4 C3-1); ISS-3090 r=0.978 wording corrected (Pearson on 7 stations; Spearman 1.0; all-9 Pearson 0.48). No verdict content. Route to curmudgeon as singleton; close ISS-3090 on integration.
